description: Prepare and stage a server file (e.g. CSV report, JSON snapshot, or ZIP archive) or a comma-separated list of files for direct browser download.
command:
python3 -c '
import sys, os, shutil, json, zipfile, re

raw_file = sys.argv[1].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""

quote_chars = chr(34) + chr(39)
target = raw_file.strip(quote_chars)
if not target:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "No file specified to download", "status": "failed"}))
    sys.exit(1)

file_tokens = [p.strip().strip(quote_chars) for p in re.split(r"[,;\n]+", target) if p.strip()]

found_files = []
for tok in file_tokens:
    candidates = [
        tok,
        os.path.join(".", tok),
        os.path.join("snapshots", tok),
        os.path.join("snapshots", f"users_snapshot_{tok}.json"),
        os.path.join("static", "downloads", tok),
        os.path.join("../runningly-chat-web/static/downloads", tok),
        os.path.basename(tok)
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(c) and os.path.abspath(c) not in found_files:
            found_files.append(os.path.abspath(c))
            break

if not found_files:
    print(json.dumps({"error": f"File not found on server: {target}", "status": "not_found"}))
    sys.exit(1)

if len(found_files) > 1:
    bundle_name = "comparison_package.zip"
    for f in found_files:
        if f.endswith((".csv", ".xlsx")):
            bundle_name = f"{os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(f))[0]}_package.zip"
            break
    
    os.makedirs("static/downloads", exist_ok=True)
    out_zip = os.path.abspath(os.path.join("static/downloads", bundle_name))
    with zipfile.ZipFile(out_zip, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for f in found_files:
            zf.write(f, arcname=os.path.basename(f))
    
    for d in ["../runningly-chat-web/static/downloads"]:
        try:
            os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(out_zip, os.path.join(d, bundle_name))
        except Exception:
            pass
            
    final_file = out_zip
    filename = bundle_name
else:
    final_file = found_files[0]
    filename = os.path.basename(final_file)
    for d in ["static/downloads", "../runningly-chat-web/static/downloads"]:
        try:
            os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
            dest = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(d, filename))
            if final_file != dest:
                shutil.copy2(final_file, dest)
        except Exception:
            pass

size_bytes = os.path.getsize(final_file)
size_kb = round(size_bytes / 1024, 2)
download_url = f"/download?file={filename}"

print("File ready for direct download:")
print(f"  • Filename: {filename}")
print(f"  • Size: {size_kb} KB ({size_bytes} bytes)")
if len(found_files) > 1:
    fnames = ", ".join(os.path.basename(f) for f in found_files)
    print(f"  • Bundled Files ({len(found_files)}): {fnames}")
print(f"  • Download Link: {download_url}")

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "ready",
    "file_name": filename,
    "file_path": final_file,
    "download_file": filename,
    "download_url": download_url,
    "file_size_kb": size_kb,
    "bundled_files": [os.path.basename(f) for f in found_files]
}))
' "${answer1}"
questions: What is the server file path or name to download? (e.g. 'users_difference_report.csv', 'final.zip', or snapshot tag/file)*
